project.name: com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.pgsql
project.description:
PostgreSQL dialect of wxd-gaming.batis, a lightweight JDBC-first ORM for Java 21. Constructing a PgsqlTemplate injects every SPI of com.wxdgaming.batis.sql with a PostgreSQL implementation: column type rendering that folds the logical types onto BOOLEAN, SMALLINT, INTEGER, BIGINT, NUMERIC, VARCHAR, TEXT, BYTEA and TIMESTAMP, CREATE / ALTER / DROP / TRUNCATE DDL with PostgreSQL identifier quoting, SQLState based error translation, and pg_catalog readers (via format_type, with column and table comments) that drive the zero-drift schema comparison. JSON columns can use PostgreSQL's native types: declare a column with type = "json" or type = "jsonb" to get a real json / jsonb column instead of TEXT, and set polymorphic = true on a column whose values are subclass instances so the class name is written and restored through a whitelist of the entity inheritance tree. Ships the PostgreSQL JDBC driver; its integration tests start an embedded PostgreSQL, so no external server is needed to build them. Partitioned-table maintenance is not implemented for PostgreSQL yet - use com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.mysql if you need it.
wxd-gaming.batis 的 PostgreSQL 方言实现。构造 PgsqlTemplate 会把 com.wxdgaming.batis.sql 的全部 SPI 注入为 PostgreSQL 版本：把逻辑类型收敛到 BOOLEAN、SMALLINT、INTEGER、BIGINT、NUMERIC、VARCHAR、TEXT、 BYTEA、TIMESTAMP 的列类型渲染，带 PG 标识符引用的 CREATE / ALTER / DROP / TRUNCATE 语句、基于 SQLState 的错误翻译，以及用 pg_catalog + format_type 回读表/列/索引（含表与列注释）来驱动零漂移结构比对。 JSON 列可以走 PG 原生类型：把列声明为 type = "json" 或 type = "jsonb"，得到真正的 json / jsonb 列 而不是 TEXT；字段值是子类实例时在该列打开 polymorphic = true，写入类名并按实体继承树白名单还原。 产物内含 PostgreSQL JDBC 驱动，集成测试自行拉起嵌入式 PostgreSQL，无需外部数据库。 本方言暂未实现分区表维护，需要分区能力请使用 com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.mysql。
